title: Explicit pullback comparisons and the local inverse DNC orientation
statement: In the finite setting P, retain the original comparisonPull, restriction, unitChange and coordinate constructions formerly attached to lem-pur-diagonal-affine-counit-restriction. For an open square k:O→W, j:U→X with k W.ι=O.ι j, restrictionAlong is the specified derived pullback compositor, equality comparison and site comparison. For any normalized Chart C over affine target V, localInverse is tate followed by theta_C inverse followed by the pullback of nu*(unitChange). These are actual constructed isomorphisms and morphisms, with no existence witness or new proof obligation.

proof.text: Form the displayed inverse-image composition, site and unit isomorphisms. Compose the four-factor inverse with the endpoint comparisons. The existing coordinate map is retained verbatim.

def localInverse (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [HasCompactification f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (C : OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V) :
    (OrientationRefinement.pull P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)) ≅
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f))
